none: PAS ESS-E3E251: Roman copper alloy nummus of Crispus, dating AD317-326.
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy nummus of Crispus (AD317-326), probably dating AD 319. Reece period 16. Obverse shows the bust of Crispus facing right, most of the inscription has worn away but what remains, reads CRIS[PVS ---]. The reverse shows two winged victories holding a shield over an altar with a large cross in the centre. The inscription reads [VICTORIAE LAETAE ]PRINC PERP. Probably minted in Siscia, RIC…
